subject: exp-dym
title: EXP.DY.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 229 (WAC-27). EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) is the subject; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. The title names EXP-DY (expansion dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and POL-DYM (political dynamics). From ACC-FT: HI-P (high purpose) and INFO-DS (information dissemination). From HI-P: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From INFO-DS: DEF (definition), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", and AFL-DT (affinity dictates).
